flash_log: UTF-16 re-encoding of the source flash log, preceded by the command line, because collector_v2.py reads flash.log as UTF-16.
flash_result: Values copied from the flash section of the source preflight record.
identification_log: Derived extract of the same esptool output, because collector_v2.py requires the board MAC in identification.log. No separate flash-id was run, as for HBPSN-09 to 17.
host_tls_probe: host_tls_probe.json in the source preflight folder: one host-only TLS 1.3 connection to 127.0.0.1:14568 before the flash, no MQTT bytes, COM6 not touched.
automatic_post_flash_boot: Setup only; excluded from the formal session by the measured-reset log boundaries.
